notes: Grades 1-8 use the new NCF-SE 2023 NCERT textbooks (Grades 1-2 from 2023-24, 3 and 6 from 2024-25, 4/5/7/8 from 2025-26).

Grade 9: CBSE introduced the NCF-SE 2023 scheme in Class IX in 2026-27 (CBSE circular Acad-14/2026). New NCERT books: Kaveri (English), Ganga (Hindi), Sharada (Sanskrit), Ganita Manjari Part 1 & 2 (Maths), Exploration (Science), Understanding Society: India and Beyond Part 1 & 2 (Social Science). Old books (Beehive/Moments, Kshitij/Kritika/Sparsh/Sanchayan, Shemushi, Mathematics, Science, Contemporary India-I, India and the Contemporary World-I, Democratic Politics-I, Economics) are retired for Class 9.

Grade 9 Ganita Manjari Part 2 (chapters 9-14) went on sale 21 Sep 2026; Understanding Society Part 2 on ~29-30 Sep 2026. Both are new books, so there is no CBSE 'deleted chapters' list for Grade 9 Maths/Science; content was restructured instead (e.g. Gravitation is folded into 'How Forces Affect Motion'; Reproduction moved from Class 10 to Class 9; new Earth-science chapter; Maths now includes coordinates, probability, sequences/AP-GP, algorithms, linear equations in two variables).

Grade 9 Social Science is ONE integrated book (Understanding Society: India and Beyond). It has been split here into history/geography/civics/economics by chapter discipline; 'n' is the chapter's position in the combined Part 1 + Part 2 book. Part 2 chapter titles (n=10-16: Oceans and Life; Life on Earth; Building a Resilient India (1000-1700 CE); India and the World-I (1900 BCE-1200 CE); Authority; From Ideas to Startups; Smart Ways to Manage Your Finances) come from a secondary source (studyrankers) and the numbering/discipline assignment is inferred — UNVERIFIED against the printed book. 'Understanding Social Science' (ch 1) is an introduction to all disciplines and is placed under history.
Grade 9 Science (Exploration): only one 13-chapter volume (First Edition April 2026) was found; no Part 2 was reported. Verify whether a second volume is issued.
Grade 9 Hindi (Ganga): sources differ slightly — one lists 14 items including two supplementary 'साथ-साथ पढ़ें' pieces; the 12-chapter core list is used here.
Grade 10: NCERT confirmed no new Class 10 books in 2026-27 (new books from 2027-28). Rationalised (2023-24 onwards) NCERT books are used.

Grade 10 Maths — deleted from rationalised NCERT/CBSE syllabus: chapter 'Constructions' (entire chapter); within chapters, removed topics include Euclid's division lemma, area of a triangle (coordinate geometry), frustum of a cone, conversion of solids/more-than-two-solid combinations, step-deviation mean and cumulative-frequency graphs, proofs of some similarity theorems. (Per Oswaal deleted-syllabus 2026-27 list; treat sub-topic list as secondary-source.)

Grade 10 Science — deleted chapters (since 2023-24 rationalisation, still out for 2026-27): Periodic Classification of Elements, Sources of Energy, Sustainable Management of Natural Resources; 'Heredity and Evolution' reduced to 'Heredity'. CBSE 2026-27 Unit V lists only 'Our Environment'.

Grade 10 Social Science per 2026-27 syllabus: History ch 4 'The Age of Industrialisation' is for periodic assessment only; Geography ch 7 'Lifelines' map work only in board exam; Economics ch 5 'Consumer Rights' (in book) is not in the syllabus (project work) and is omitted. Democratic Politics-II chapters removed in rationalisation: Democracy and Diversity, Popular Struggles and Movements, Challenges to Democracy.

Grade 10 Hindi: Course A (Kshitij-2 + Kritika-2) shown; Course B uses Sparsh-2 + Sanchayan-2. Rationalisation removed from Kshitij-2: Dev (Savaiya/Kavitt), Chhaya Mat Chhoona, Kanyadaan, Manaviya Karuna ki Divya Chamak (and earlier others); Kritika-2: Ehi Thaiyan Jhulani Herani Ho Rama, George Pancham ki Naak.
Sanskrit is listed for Grades 6-10 as the usual third language (6-8) / optional language (9-10); Grade 9 Sanskrit 'Sharada' chapter list is from a secondary source (educart) — UNVERIFIED.

UNVERIFIED / secondary-source-only chapter lists (verify against NCERT PDFs before publishing): Grade 1 Hindi Sarangi (sources disagree on a few titles, e.g. 'रीना का दिन' vs 'मीना का दिन', 'तीन साथी' vs 'तीन हाथी'); Grade 4 Santoor and Veena; Grade 4 Our Wondrous World (from a 2026-27 school academic plan); Grade 5 Santoor and Veena (ch 9 'न्याय' uncertain); Grade 6 Poorvi chapters 6-16 and Exploring Society Grade 6 (from memory of the official book, consistent with partial listings); Grade 7 and 8 Malhar (10 chapters each per two secondary sources); Grade 8 Exploring Society Part 2 order (teachoo); Grade 9 Kaveri (prose/poem pairing inferred).
Grade 1 and 2 books also have a 'Vidyapravesh' school-readiness module and end-of-book puzzles/revision; these are not counted as chapters.
Topic phrases are short paraphrases written for the app, not official learning outcomes.

2026-11-04 correction: Grade 9 Understanding Society Part 2 has six chapters per multiple sources (InvincibleEdge, Tiwari Academy, Elets, AglaSem): 10 Oceans and Life, 11 Life on Earth, 12 Resistance and Resilience (1000-1700 CE), 13 Governance and Public Policy, 14 Managing Your Personal Finances, 15 From Ideas to Startups. 'India and the World-I' and 'Authority' are not in the printed book and were removed. Still to be confirmed against the printed NCERT book.

Grades 11-12: BOOKS FOR 2026-27: NCERT's advisory of 17 March 2026 (reported by Educart and Learnify) says Class 11 keeps the existing books in 2026-27, with new NCF-SE books due from 2027-28. No new Class 12 book has been announced. All lists below use the rationalised books (2023-24 onwards), checked against 2026-27 syllabus copies (Delhi DoE edustud.nic.in, school booklets, PW, Oswal, Aakash).

Grades 11-12: Economics pairing CORRECTED: the CBSE 2026-27 syllabus pairs Class 11 = Statistics for Economics + Introductory Microeconomics and Class 12 = Introductory Macroeconomics + Indian Economic Development. NCERT labels Indian Economic Development as a 'Class 11' book and Introductory Microeconomics as a 'Class 12' book, but CBSE teaches them the other way round. This file follows CBSE.

Grades 11-12: Lists follow the CBSE 2026-27 syllabus. Chapters CBSE does not examine are left out even where the NCERT book still prints them, and 'n' is renumbered continuously, so it may not match the printed chapter numbers.

Grades 11-12: Chapters left out by rationalisation or the CBSE syllabus. English 12: An Elementary School Classroom in a Slum, Should Wizard Hit Mommy, Evans Tries an O-Level. Physics 11: Physical World. Physics 12: Communication Systems. Biology 12: Reproduction in Organisms, Strategies for Enhancement in Food Production, Environmental Issues. Maths 11: Mathematical Reasoning, Principle of Mathematical Induction. Economics 11: Measures of Dispersion. Micro: Non-Competitive Markets. IED: Poverty, Infrastructure. Geography 12: human settlements chapter of the Human Geography book. Psychology 11: Bases of Human Behaviour. Psychology 12: Psychology and Life, Developing Psychological Skills. These deletion names are from recall of the 2023-24 rationalisation and were not each re-checked.

Grades 11-12: Accountancy 12: Accounting for Not-for-Profit Organisations is still Chapter 1 of NCERT Part I (Tiwari Academy lists it) but is not in the CBSE 2026-27 syllabus, so it is left out. In Part B, CBSE lets students take Computerised Accounting instead of Analysis of Financial Statements + Cash Flow Statement. Excluded topics: piecemeal distribution, sale to a company, insolvency of partners, TDS on debenture interest.

Grades 11-12: Accountancy 11: Accounts from Incomplete Records is in the CBSE 2026-27 syllabus (statement of affairs method only), so it is included. Its exact place in NCERT Part II is not verified. Chapters are in NCERT book order: Trial Balance comes before Depreciation, while the CBSE syllabus lists Depreciation first.

Grades 11-12: Business Studies 11: chapter 8 is titled as in the CBSE syllabus ('Small Business and Enterprises'). The printed NCERT title may differ slightly (e.g. 'Small Business and Entrepreneurship'). UNVERIFIED.

Grades 11-12: Sociology: the CBSE 2026-27 syllabus (Delhi DoE and Oswal copies) leaves out Indian Society ch 4 (The Market as a Social Institution) and Social Change and Development ch 3, 6 and 7 (The Story of Indian Democracy, Globalisation and Social Change, Mass Media and Communications). Class 11 leaves out Introducing Sociology ch 5 (Doing Sociology: Research Methods) and Understanding Society ch 1 and 3 (Social Structure, Stratification and Social Processes; Environment and Society). The missing chapter numbers are confirmed, but the names of the omitted chapters are from recall.

Grades 11-12: Geography: theory books only. Practicals: Class 11 'Practical Work in Geography Part I' (maps, scale, latitude/longitude/time, map projections, topographical maps). Class 12 'Practical Work in Geography Part II' (data sources, data processing, graphical representation, spatial information technology). In Class 11, World Climate and Climate Change, Biodiversity and Conservation, and Natural Hazards and Disasters are assessed through internal assessment or projects, not the theory paper (PW).

Grades 11-12: Hindi Core: lists are the full rationalised Aroh/Vitan contents: 16 + 3 chapters in Class 11 and 15 + 3 in Class 12. Vitan 2 'Diary ke Panne' was deleted. A school booklet (Lucknow Public School) teaches only a subset of Aroh 1 poems. Whether CBSE 2026-27 prescribes every Aroh chapter could not be confirmed, because the CBSE PDF text was unreadable (image/legacy font). Hindi Core also uses 'Abhivyakti aur Madhyam' for writing skills; it is not mapped here. Topics are written in English.
Grades 11-12: Hindi Core is marked optional: it is the usual second language, but students may take another language or skip it under CBSE's 5-subject scheme.

Grades 11-12: Computer Science (083): the CBSE syllabus does not follow the NCERT chapters one-to-one. Class 11 leaves out NCERT 'Emerging Trends'. NCERT Class 11 'Functions' is taught in Class 12 per CBSE, except for Python modules (math, random, statistics), which are folded into the 'Tuples and Dictionaries' entry here. Class 12 leaves out NCERT Queue, Sorting, Searching, Understanding Data and Security Aspects, and adds Python revision, functions and Python-MySQL connectivity. Chapter titles here are a CBSE-aligned blend, not exact NCERT titles.
Grades 11-12: Science-stream note: in practice students take Physics + Chemistry + either Maths (PCM) or Biology (PCB), or all four. Both maths and biology are listed as science core.
Grades 11-12: Arts-stream note: arts students choose any 3-4 of history, polsci, geography, psychology, sociology, economics. The 'core' list for arts is the pool of electives, not a mandatory set.

Grades 11-12: Chemistry 12 and Biology 12: CBSE 2026-27 says some topics (e.g. Surface Chemistry, Polymers, environmental issues) are assessed only formatively. They are not included as chapters (Aakash copy of the CBSE syllabus).
Grades 11-12: Political Science 12: NCERT revised the text of Politics in India since Independence in 2024-25, but chapter titles are unchanged.
